scope: Complete source Ising Notebook: six periodic spins, J=10, h=-20, five QAOA layers, CVaR quantile 0.7 and 100 actual native objective evaluations using explicit bounded coordinate search. Includes convergence, optimized and uniform 2048-shot local samples (seeds 123/456), ranked solutions and 30-bin weighted histograms. Source energy equals negative frozen exported cost on all 64 states; negate gammas and retain the frozen counterpart unchanged. Independent Circuit checks all complex amplitudes. Exact optimization probabilities are separate from finite samples. Budget exhaustion does not certify convergence or a pure ground state. No private optimizer equivalence, hardware, speedup, API or dependency claim.
